jess-ux: Quick design review request 65: thinking through keyboard-first nav for the new sidebar IA. Two flows: quick-jump (single-keystroke palette) vs persistent keyboard focus ring when you arrow through clusters. Which do we prioritize for initial roll? mike-frontend: Both sound nice but for rollout I'd prefer palette-first (less keyboard trap risk). We already have an infra for 'g then p' style shortcuts. Implementation note: palette should not change URL, but selecting an item should. tara-a11y: Palette is fine. Important a11y bits: 1) when a deep link opens into a panel, focus must land on the H1 and a live region should announce the panel name; 2) skip links order: Skip to Main Content, Skip to Projects, Skip to Search. Keyboard users expect Skip to Main first. raj-prod: Also product asks that shared deep links copy to clipboard include the panel + anchor so support teams can link directly to a log line. Example: `/app/org/123/projects/42?panel=logs&anchor=line-512`. We should confirm how this interacts with collapsed nav state. mike-frontend: FYI found a subtle bug: when opening a deep link with a fragment we scroll to the anchor but a later focus handler moves focus to a dialog (we open a tip), which ruins the perceived location. Proposed: defer non-essential modals for 250ms after navigation or suppress their auto-open when arriving via deep link. jess-ux: Agree on deferring modals on deep opens. Also UX suggestion: breadcrumbs should represent user task path: Projects > ProjectName > Metrics (not include ephemeral panel controls). Use chevrons (>) and no trailing punctuation. tara-a11y: Breadcrumb HTML suggestion:
  1. Projects
    2. ...
. Use aria-current="page" on the current crumb. Also ensure each crumb is keyboard focusable and has 48px tap target. mike-frontend: Small router sketch: ``` // route shape /app/:org/projects/:projId?panel=metrics&anchor=line-512 // behavior - on route change (pushState) -> render panel, set focus to panel heading, update breadcrumb - on UI-only toggle (collapse sidebar) -> do NOT modify history - if incoming path matches old /workspace/:id -> server-side 301 to new path ``` This avoids history.replace issues and keeps back button sane. raj-prod: Can we add a tiny tooltip copy for the Projects nav item: "Projects 45 team workspaces"? Also want microcopy when copying deep link: "Link copied: opens Metrics at line 512" ci-bot: build-status: e2e-deeplink-test failed on staging (test: deep-link-scroll-preserve). See logs: https://ci.example/4823 :x: mike-frontend: Thanks, I'll run the repro locally. My hunch is the test expects fragment jump before focus management; I can add an explicit wait for fragment target then set focus. tara-a11y: One more a11y nit: when the sidebar is collapsed, ensure skip links still reach the same main regions (do not swap tab order). Collapsing should be visual-only. jess-ux: OK final call for this thread: palette-first keyboard entry, breadcrumb semantics as noted, preserve deep-link fragment + panel in copy-to-clipboard, defer non-essential modals on deep open, skip-link order fixed. Mike to open FE PR with tests; Tara will provide a11y checklist; Raj will update product microcopy. mike-frontend: Opening PR tomorrow; will ping for quick review. ci-bot: build-status: staging build for nav-ux-branch passed (build #4830) :white_check_mark:
